text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...What was that, I wonder? It feels as 
though something has sprouted within me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—My heart is leaping with excitement. My 
body yearns to run. It feels almost as 
if... we're holding hands together.
